author: sophie.claes@foo.be
title: Ravi's single permit approved + lessons learned
body:
Hi all,

Good news: Ravi Kumar's single permit was approved today. Total time from submission: about 4.5 months. He'll start on 1 August.

Lessons learned, for the next non-EU hire:
- The file was sent back once because the salary in the contract and the application form didn't match exactly (gross annual vs monthly). Use gross annual everywhere.
- The apostille took 4 weeks.
- The municipality appointment in Ghent had a 3 week waiting list, book it as soon as the arrival date is known.

Please loop me in early for future cases.

Sophie
